title: This free GitHub repo replaced my SEO agency
description:
Ranking tenth used to still count.

Answers only have one slot.

Ten blue links had room.

Page one fit everybody.

Now GPT returns one answer.

No fourth place in a sentence.

You're in it or you're invisible.

Your agency still reports positions.

Two, three grand a month for that.

Meanwhile the traffic already moved.

Eighteen agents do that same work.

Audits. Backlinks. Keyword strategy.

Free and open source.

Built to rank inside answers.

Like renting the best billboard.

On a road nobody drives now.

The work didn't get harder.

The finish line moved.

Go get inside the answer.

#seo #claude #github #opensource #gpt
